```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
# Directory containing the files
dir <- "/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/06_figure5_Chiseq_BATF_SRG3_MLL/Figure5a_5b_Rscript/data"

# Output directory for plots
output_dir <- "/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/06_figure5_Chiseq_BATF_SRG3_MLL/Figure5a_5b_Rscript/plot"

# List of files to process
files <- c(
  "matrix_ATAC_bed_log2FCless1_FDR0.05_BRG1.txt",
  "matrix_ATAC_bed_log2FCless1_FDR0.05_SRG3.txt",
  "matrix_ATAC_bed_log2FCless1_FDR0.05_MLL4.txt",
  "matrix_ATAC_bed_log2FCless1_FDR0.05_WDR5.txt",
  "matrix_BATF_24hr_bed_WT_JunBKO_1k.txt",
  "matrix_JunB_less_ACRs_aBATF_WT_JunBKO.txt"
)

# Function to process each file
process_file <- function(filename, dir, output_dir) {

  cat("Processing:", filename, "\n")

  # Read matrix
  original_df <- read.table(
    file.path(dir, filename),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    header = TRUE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  cat("Dimension:", dim(original_df), "\n")

  # Each sample contains 200 bins
  bins_per_sample <- 200

  # Number of samples
  n_samples <- ncol(original_df) / bins_per_sample

  if (n_samples != 6) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Expected 6 samples (1200 columns), found",
        n_samples,
        "samples"
      )
    )
  }

  # Calculate mean signal across all peaks
  means_list <- lapply(
    seq(1, ncol(original_df), by = bins_per_sample),
    function(start_col) {

      end_col <- start_col + bins_per_sample - 1

      colMeans(
        original_df[, start_col:end_col, drop = FALSE],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  )

  mean_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(cbind, means_list))

  colnames(mean_df) <- c(
    "wt1", "wt2", "wt3",
    "ko1", "ko2", "ko3"
  )

  # Average replicates
  avg_df <- data.frame(
    WT = rowMeans(mean_df[, c("wt1", "wt2", "wt3")], na.rm = TRUE),
    KO = rowMeans(mean_df[, c("ko1", "ko2", "ko3")], na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  # Create title
  plot_title <- gsub("matrix_", "", filename)
  plot_title <- gsub("\\.txt$", "", plot_title)
  plot_title <- gsub("_", " ", plot_title)

  # Output file
  plot_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      "plot_",
      gsub(" ", "_", plot_title),
      "_profile.png"
    )
  )

  dir.create(
    output_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  # Plot
  png(
    plot_file,
    width = 1200,
    height = 1000,
    res = 300
  )

  par(mar = c(5, 5, 3, 2))

  matplot(
    x = 1:nrow(avg_df),
    y = avg_df,
    type = "l",
    lty = 1,
    lwd = 3,
    col = c("blue", "red"),
    xaxt = "n",
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "Mean signal",
    main = plot_title,
    ylim = range(avg_df, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  axis(
    1,
    at = c(1, 100, 200),
    labels = c("-1 kb", "Center", "+1 kb")
  )

  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = c("WT", "KO"),
    col = c("blue", "red"),
    lwd = 3,
    bty = "n"
  )

  box()

  dev.off()

  cat("Saved:", plot_file, "\n\n")
}

# Run all files
for (file in files) {
  process_file(file, dir, output_dir)
}



```
